items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: the District Attorney, Henry Berry III, intervened in the ceremony... and swore me in then and there as a duly appointed special assistant to the District Attorney

ctx.x: I also carry and hold a full commission on Jefferson County, Arkansas sheriff's department, and I carry that badge. I ws saying before that I have a commission -- and it's a full commission, but it's all over now because that sheriff is gone -- Bernalillo County in the state of New Mexico, I got a full commission in Jefferson County, as I just said, and I am an honorary citizen of Pine Bluff, Arkansas -- to make that commission binding, and one last aside, and I will finish with the Odessa parties.

While being a guest in my home town of Portland, Maine last December -- I covered that in some tapes before, when my union presented me with a plaque, the District Attorney was present while I was setting up the drums, and he said he had heard about my accumulating standing as a peace officer in the different states, and he had heard of my father's standing in the past, and I told him that in all my travels around this country, and sheriff's appointments in other states, that with my family's background, I didn't…

So he went to his office and brought back a state of Maine, Cumberland County District Attorney Commission, signed and sealed, and swore me in then and there as a duly appointed special assistant to the District Attorney, Cumberland County, Maine, the 16th of December, 1978.
